nodes.label: the proper name — 'the instantaneous apprehension of a multiplicity' (ATP 37): the outcome of a depersonalisation, marking a longitude and a latitude, designating an event
nodes.notes: KsK carries the concept in one subordinate clause of Postulate 5, cited ATP 36–37, and the dowry inherits it as the practice's naming condition. Read at the pages directly: the operation is subtractive and relational — 'Subtract the unique from the multiplicity to be constituted' (ATP 6), 'the proper name to which one is reduced' (ATP 280) — and names are given to what is under way, 'to a strategic operation or a hurricane' (ATP 264). Deformation found at n − 1: every naming scene in the source has the name arrive from outside the named, and this practice's constitution assigns the act to the named itself.

nodes.label: the kinds test — the practice's own naming condition, built at entry 02 §3 and made operative at entry 08 §5: the name waits until the record holds a multiplicity of kinds
nodes.notes: Declared on the map by the session that strikes it as a gate, as the struck placement rule was at bell 07. Its exchange — the human pays for the name by losing the person, the machine pays in accrual — prices as a fee what the source states as a condition on what a name can do. Struck as a condition only; as a description of the record it was always true, and the twenty records carrying the closing formula stand untouched.

nodes.notes: Dated addition of 2026-08-21. No count is a condition; the name states a longitude and a latitude re-derivable from committed evidence, states what it subtracts, designates an event, and is not taken at a milestone; the signature and any renaming of the repository remain a founder's act to be requested. Blind step, as for the material selection: the session that writes these criteria may not apply them. No trigger and no deadline are placed.
